subtopic: Financial Professional Compensation and Conflicts of Interest
source_evidence: Your financial professional could receive more or less compensation depending on the share class you purchase. Accordingly, your financial professional may limit which share classes are available, and this may be because of compensation they receive from the funds or their sponsors.
question: Why might a financial professional limit which mutual fund share classes they offer, and what can an investor ask if a fund has multiple classes?
answer: A financial professional may receive different compensation depending on the share class, and that compensation may affect which classes they make available. If a fund has multiple classes with different fees and expenses, ask the professional why they chose or recommended that particular class for you.
